review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-13 of the strings added on the claude-934-measure-1113 branch (item 934) and the claude-chaining-stuck-1113 branch against the exact English source: the labels and tooltips of the Measure settings funk_object_features, zernike, channel_names, measure_gpu_check and measure_gpu_check_rtol, and the chaining strip's 'Could not look up chained inputs' message. Written directly, with no machine-translation draft. Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5). No human or native-speaker signoff.

records.source: One short name per entry of channels, for example ['dapi', 'gfp', 'a594', 'af750']. The measurement columns then carry these names in place of channel_<i> (cell_dapi_mean_intensity instead of cell_channel_0_mean_intensity), as the OPS phenotype tables (ops_ph_channels) do. Names are lowercased and must be unique, without spaces. Plots and analyses that ask for channel_<i> columns do not find renamed ones. Empty keeps the channel_<i> names. Default None.
records.translation: Eitt stutt heiti á hverja færslu í channels, til dæmis ['dapi', 'gfp', 'a594', 'af750']. Mælidálkarnir bera þá þessi heiti í stað channel_<i> (cell_dapi_mean_intensity í stað cell_channel_0_mean_intensity), eins og OPS-svipgerðartöflurnar (ops_ph_channels) gera. Heitin eru færð í lágstafi og verða að vera einstök, án bila. Gröf og greiningar sem biðja um channel_<i> dálka finna ekki endurnefnda dálka. Tómt heldur channel_<i> heitunum. Sjálfgefið None.

records.source: Add the object features of Funk et al. 2022 (optical pooled screens) to every 2-D object: the mass displacement of every channel (the distance from the object's centroid to its intensity-weighted centroid), Pearson's r of every channel pair over the object's pixels (correlation_<a>_<b>), and the form factor (4 pi area / perimeter squared). The OPS setting ops_ph_funk_features gives the same values from the same functions. Mass displacement and form factor are not repeated when profile_features already writes them. Default False.
records.translation: Bæta hlutareiginleikum Funk et al. 2022 (sjónrænar safnskimanir) við hvern 2-D hlut: massatilfærslu hverrar rásar (fjarlægðinni frá massamiðju hlutarins að styrkvegnu massamiðjunni hans), Pearson r hvers rásapars yfir díla hlutarins (correlation_<a>_<b>) og lögunarstuðlinum (4 pi flatarmál / ummál í öðru veldi). OPS-stillingin ops_ph_funk_features gefur sömu gildi úr sömu föllum. Massatilfærsla og lögunarstuðull eru ekki endurtekin þegar profile_features skrifar þau nú þegar. Sjálfgefið False.

records.source: Before a measure_gpu run, measure the first field on the CPU and on the GPU and compare every column; when a column differs by more than measure_gpu_check_rtol, the run stops before any field is measured and lists the columns. Only read with measure_gpu on and a CUDA device visible. The OPS setting ops_ph_measure_gpu_check runs the same check. Default True.
records.translation: Fyrir measure_gpu keyrslu, mæla fyrsta sjónsviðið á CPU og á GPU og bera saman hvern dálk; þegar dálkur víkur meira en measure_gpu_check_rtol stöðvast keyrslan áður en nokkurt sjónsvið er mælt og telur upp dálkana. Aðeins lesið þegar measure_gpu er á og CUDA-tæki er sýnilegt. OPS-stillingin ops_ph_measure_gpu_check keyrir sömu athugun. Sjálfgefið True.

records.source: The relative tolerance of measure_gpu_check: a column passes when every value is within this fraction of its CPU value, or both are missing. Default 0.0001.
records.translation: Hlutfallsleg vikmörk measure_gpu_check: dálkur stenst þegar hvert gildi er innan þessa hlutfalls af CPU-gildi sínu, eða bæði vantar. Sjálfgefið 0.0001.

records.source: Zernike moments of each object's shape (zernike_0 to zernike_24), which need the mahotas package (spacr[zernike]). None computes them when mahotas is installed and skips them otherwise, so the same settings file can give different columns on two computers. True always computes them and stops the run when mahotas is missing; False never computes them. The OPS setting ops_ph_zernike is the same switch. Default None.
records.translation: Zernike-vægi lögunar hvers hlutar (zernike_0 til zernike_24), sem þurfa mahotas-pakkann (spacr[zernike]). None reiknar þau þegar mahotas er uppsett og sleppir þeim annars, svo sama stillingaskrá getur gefið mismunandi dálka á tveimur tölvum. True reiknar þau alltaf og stöðvar keyrsluna þegar mahotas vantar; False reiknar þau aldrei. OPS-stillingin ops_ph_zernike er sami rofi. Sjálfgefið None.
